$comment: Uncached `test` task seconds per Nx project (or `<project>:test:shard-<n>` task) for the CI test-shard dealer (scripts/src/test-shard-dealer.ts). Source: the executed (not cache-replayed) `test` and `test:shard-<n>` tasks in the 759 `Affected (test-<n>)` job logs longer than 4 min of the 173 green merge-group runs of ci.yml created 2026-11-18T06:00Z to 2026-11-21T11:39Z, on hosted ubuntu runners at --parallel=1 (tau-brain research/artifacts/ci-decomposition-blueprint/remeasure-2026-11-23/). A task's seconds are its wall time in the streamed job log, from its `> nx run` line to its last prefixed output line (within 1 s of Vitest's own Duration); each value is the median of the samples since 2026-11-19T05:00Z where a unit has three or more, otherwise of all its samples (replicad went from about 74 s to about 300 s with tau #2611 on 2026-11-19). Units of 45 s or more are listed, plus every unit of the previous snapshot. A unit not listed weighs defaultSeconds, the median measured unit. `ui` is the sum of its six shard tasks, for a deal that ever sees `ui` whole. Refresh when a listed unit's median moves by more than a quarter, when a project is split, or when this snapshot is older than 60 days.
